review.summary: The compact SUV silhouette, wheels and roof rails are recognizable, but the body has conspicuous rectangular gouges below the opposite-side door handles and a smaller hole on the hero-side lower door. These are unsupported panel breaks, not reference trim.

issues.problem: Rectangular recessed gouges and small puncture interrupt otherwise solid door panels; especially obvious in opposite view.

review.summary: Final 14234-triangle asset matches the accepted source in all five views. Door/body contours, roof rails, four wheels, dark trim, green paint and lamps remain stable after reduction. Minor source glazing simplification persists without new visible damage; fresh GLB/FBX technical checks pass.

issues.problem: Retains accepted source's stylized bright windscreen/interior.

issues.problem: Simplified interior and bright windscreen reflections differ from reference but remain coherent.
